channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: US administrations asked Musk to switch Starlink on or off in multiple countries: Report
item.description: Biden and Trump governments sought SpaceX's help for internet access in Iran and military communications in Ukraine

item.title: Who is Ashoke Sen? Indian physicist honoured with 2026 Oskar Klein Medal for pioneering work on string theory
item.description: Indian physicist Ashoke Sen has become the first Indian to receive the 2026 Oskar Klein Medal for his pioneering contributions to string theory, gravity and black-hole physics. Professor at ICTS-TIFR, Bengaluru, Sen delivered the Oskar Klein Memorial Lecture in Stockholm.

item.title: Which countries have the world’s largest militaries? China leads in troops, US in air power — where does India stand?
item.description: China leads the world in active troops, tanks and naval assets, while the US dominates military aircraft and fleet tonnage. India ranks second in active personnel, fifth in tanks, and fourth in aircraft and naval assets, according to Global Firepower’s 2026 data.

item.title: Jaishankar in Baku: Can trade and connectivity help Azerbaijan reset ties with India after Operation Sindoor fallout?
item.description: A year after Operation Sindoor strained India-Azerbaijan ties, S Jaishankar’s Baku visit seeks a reset through trade, energy and connectivity. With bilateral trade at $401 mn in 2025, can economic cooperation overcome tensions over Azerbaijan’s support for Pakistan and India’s ties with Armenia?

item.title: Whopping ₹240 cr jackpot! Who is Anilkumar Bolla? Meet UAE lottery winner Indian techie - what he plans to do with prize
item.description: Anilkumar Bolla, an Indian expatriate based in Abu Dhabi, won 100 million dirham in The UAE Lottery in October 2025. A year later, the 29-year-old says his priorities include spending time with family, investing in property and exploring business opportunities.

item.title: Sonia Gandhi recalls meeting Rajiv Gandhi at a Greek restaurant in Cambridge: What she said about their first encounter
item.description: Sonia Gandhi recalls meeting former prime minister Rajiv Gandhi at a Greek restaurant in Cambridge, England, describing an instant attraction that grew into a relationship and marriage in 1968.&nbsp;

item.title: Who is Clavicular? American influencer accused of failing to pay rent and trashing $7 million California mansion
item.description: Influencer Clavicular, whose real name is Braden Eric Peters, faces allegations that he failed to pay rent and breached lease rules while hosting a Looksmaxxing Camp at a $7 million California mansion. His representative denies unpaid bills, saying camp expenses were paid upfront.

item.title: Pakistan's LPG crisis deepens as prices hit 600 PKR/kg, hundreds of trucks stranded at Iran border
item.description: Pakistan's LPG imports from Iran have halted after two key border crossings were closed, pushing up cylinder prices and raising fears of worsening shortages. Traders warn of further increases as hundreds of trucks remain stranded and both countries discuss resuming trade.

item.title: Who is Prakriti Malla? How a 14-year-old Nepali schoolgirl’s handwriting took the internet by storm
item.description: Nepali student Prakriti Malla became an internet sensation at 14 when images of her remarkably neat handwriting went viral. Her carefully spaced letters resembled printed text, earning widespread praise and recognition in Nepal and abroad.

item.title: Hunger strike, suspensions and protest for a union: Why has Jamia shifted classes online? Students speak out | Exclusive
item.description: Jamia has shifted classes online indefinitely amid tensions over students’ demand to restore the university’s students’ union. Protesters allege disciplinary action, detentions and restrictions on their agitation.

item.title: Who is IPS Officer Ankita Sharma? How she sparked controversy with AK-47 firing during Vijayadashami Shastra Puja
item.description: IPS Officer Ankita Sharma is popularly known as ‘Lady Singham.’ She recently gained a lot of attention online after a video of her from Dussehra event went viral.

item.title: Wildlife Photographer of the Year 2026: Meet India's Sitaram Raul who won the award for scorpion image in Rajasthan
item.description: Indian photographer Sitaram Raul has won the Behaviour: Invertebrates category at Wildlife Photographer of the Year 2026 for Shifting Sand, capturing a scorpion burrowing into Rajasthan’s Thar Desert after hours of patient observation.

item.title: Who is IPS officer Aditya Kumar? Fake Chief Justice case, CAT ruling, suspension and DIG promotion explained
item.description: Bihar IPS officer Aditya Kumar faces disciplinary proceedings over an alleged conspiracy to impersonate a former Patna High Court Chief Justice. The CAT has refused to quash the inquiry, while a separate departmental case against him has been closed.

item.title: UK on emergency? PM Andy Burnham urges citizens to store 3 days of food, water and cash at home; here's what's happening
item.description: The UK government has launched the ‘Be Ready campaign and urged people to store essential items such as food, water, cash and more at home for up to three days. Here’s why it is important amid wildfires, storm, cybersecurity threats and more in the nation.

item.title: Rahul Gandhi's Nov 1 INDIA bloc rally: Delhi's CTI cites ₹25K cr Dhanteras business, seeks delay— What letter to MP said
item.description: Delhi’s Chamber of Trade and Industry (CTI) has urged Rahul Gandhi to postpone the Congress rally planned for November 1 at Ramlila Maidan until after November 10, citing potential disruption to festive-season business and traffic near major markets and railway stations.

item.title: 4 Philippine Air Force pilots killed as 2 training aircraft collide midair: Report
item.description: The two SF-260 aircraft collided while flying at a low altitude during a training flight on Friday afternoon before crashing at Fernando Air Base in Lipa city, located in the coastal province of Batangas

item.title: Iran claims control of Strait of Hormuz, says 2 oil tankers hit mines, warns US warships against Persian Gulf entry
item.description: Iran claims control over the Strait of Hormuz and says two oil supertankers carrying over 4.5 million barrels struck naval mines. The claims remain unverified as Tehran warns US warships against entering the Persian Gulf amid fears of a US strike.

item.title: Noida Sector 125 fire: Blaze at hotel spreads to nearby eateries, firefighting ops underway | Video
item.description: A fire at Krishna Food Point in Sector 125 on Saturday spread to nearby eateries, causing panic. Firefighters deployed four vehicles and brought the blaze under control with police assistance. No casualties were reported.

item.title: Fodder scam case: CBI nabs Satyendra Kumar, accused on the run for 25 years from Lucknow station; all you need to know
item.description: The CBI arrested fodder scam accused Satyendra Kumar at Lucknow railway station after 25 years on the run. Traced to Nepal before returning to India, he is being brought to Ranchi on transit remand to face court proceedings.

item.title: ‘Saifu Ko Ghee Do’: How Saif Ali Khan’s viral KBC moment became a massive, unsponsored ad for Gowardhan
item.description: For Gowardhan, a dairy brand from Parag Milk Foods, Saif Ali Khan's candid humour turned into a free ad. Thanks to Saif, netizens said Gowardhan has become their top-of-mind ghee brand.

item.title: Who is Matthew VanDyke and what is next in Myanmar arms training case as court allow him to stay in US till February?
item.description: A Delhi court extended until February 24 permission for US national Matthew VanDyke and six Ukrainians to remain abroad while the NIA investigates allegations that they trained ethnic armed groups in Myanmar. VanDyke, who received default bail in September, was also allowed to return to the US.

item.title: 'Who's responsible for this mess in the first place?' Piyush Goyal ozone layer video goes viral from Berlin discussion
item.description: Piyush Goyal criticised Europe’s carbon emissions and accused developed nations of failing to deliver promised climate finance. He also warned that the EU’s carbon tax on steel could raise living costs and weaken its industries’ competitiveness.

item.title: Barack Obama enters US midterm battleground: Can he help Democrats flip Senate seats in Ohio and Michigan?
item.description: Barack Obama returns to the campaign trail in Ohio and Michigan to support Democratic Senate candidates as Republicans battle to retain control of the US Senate ahead of the 2026 midterm elect

item.title: Delhi food safety ghee raid: Over 322 kg of ghee seized from stores; here's what was found, what you should be aware of
item.description: Delhi officials seized over 322 kg of ghee from stores offering steep festive discounts amid quality concerns. While lab results are awaited, consumers have been urged to check packaging and manufacturing and expiry dates before buying.

item.title: German traveller reveals 10 things she wishes she knew before travelling to India as a solo traveller
item.description: A German vlogger’s viral video offers advice for women traveling alone in India. Her tips cover affordable transport and mobile data, visas, food delivery, hostels, and navigating local customs. She said her own experiences with street food and Indian hospitality were positive.

item.title: Odisha Police Ganjam Gambling Crackdown, Raids: 470 arrested, over ₹12.65 lakh seized ahead of Kumar Purnima
item.description: Odisha Police arrested 470 people in two days during a crackdown on gambling ahead of Kumar Purnima in Ganjam and Berhampur. Officers also seized cash and busted gambling dens as authorities warned that enforcement would continue.

item.title: Russia-Ukraine war: Melania Trump brokers localised ceasefire in Oleshky; all you need to know about the starving city
item.description: Melania Trump announced a localised Russia-Ukraine ceasefire to allow aid deliveries and civilian evacuations in Russian-occupied Oleshky, where mines, drone attacks and damaged infrastructure have left residents struggling to access food and escape safely.

item.title: IndiGo and Akasa Air extend Saudi flight suspensions: Check new dates; has Air India followed suit?
item.description: IndiGo flights to Riyadh remain cancelled until October 31 and services to three other Saudi cities until October 27. Akasa Air has extended its suspensions to Jeddah and Riyadh until November 10 and 30, respectively.

item.title: Petrol and diesel prices today, October 24: Check fuel cost in Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru
item.description: Brent oil finished out the week at the highest level since April as intensifying attacks on Saudi Arabia added to supply concerns already stoked by the US-Iran war.

item.title: Amid El Niño and fears of prolonged drought, Telangana announces 4-month employment scheme
item.description: Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy announced a four-month employment scheme starting after Sankranti to support workers. With reservoirs critically low and many pump sets dry, the government will monitor water supplies, provide cattle fodder and drinking water, and create additional workdays.

item.title: The week in charts: FPI selloff, Reliance bets, Blinkit’s expansion plans
item.description: In this weekly Plain Facts compilation, we present to you data-based insights, with easy-to-read charts, to help you delve deeper into the stories reported by Mint in the week gone by.

item.title: Earthquake today: Magnitude 7.2 quake strikes waters near Vanuatu; triggers tsunami warning
item.description: The tsunami warning was later lifted. The magnitude of the earthquake was also revised to 6.9, down from an earlier estimate of 7.2 magnitude

item.title: US ends tariffs on some Canadian products, replaces them with others amid tight mid-term race for Susan Collin in Maine
item.description: President Donald Trump will ease 50% tariffs on some Canadian agricultural and forestry-related imports starting October 30, while adding other Canadian goods to the tariff list. The change comes as trade tensions and rising costs affect border-state economies and shape a close Maine Senate race.

item.title: Paris shooting: 1 killed, 5 injured in Trappes, ahead of planned protests; Macron condemns ‘racist terrorist attack’
item.description: One person was killed and five others, including a 12-year-old girl, were injured in shootings in the Paris suburbs. Macron condemned the incident as a racist terrorist attack. Authorities arrested a 39-year-old suspect and launched an anti-terror investigation.

item.title: IMD alert for today: Cyclone brewing in Bay of Bengal; heavy rain forecasted for Tamil Nadu, Karnataka
item.description: Northeast monsoon began over Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal, Coastal Andhra Pradesh, Rayalaseema, South Interior Karnataka, and Kerala and Mahe.
